How to measure your space

  1. 1. Lawn areas: Measure length × width in feet. For irregular lawns, break into rectangles and add them with the Irregular option.
  2. 2. Garden beds and raised beds: Measure interior dimensions. For raised beds being filled from scratch, measure internal length × width × planned depth.
  3. 3. Depth guidance: 2" to top-dress a lawn · 4–6" for new garden beds · 8–12" for raised beds filled from scratch.
  4. 4. Bulk vs. bags: Bulk delivery is cheaper per cubic yard for orders over 1–2 yards. Bags are convenient for small areas.

Formula: Volume (cu yd) = Area × Depth ÷ 324. 40 lb bags = Volume (cu ft) ÷ 0.75, rounded up. See our methodology page.

Topsoil quick facts

  • 1 cubic yard = 36 bags (40 lb)
  • 1 cubic yard weighs ~2,200 lbs (1.1 tons)
  • 40 lb bag covers ~0.75 cu ft
  • Standard lawn top-dress: 2"
  • New garden bed: 4–6"
